notes.title: Patch Notes: Version 1.14EA Major Update for *The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox*
notes.content:
Patch Notes: Version 1.14EA Major Update for *The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox*

1. **Card Usage Adjustment**: At the start of a battle, the first attack from both leaders will trigger the first skill card. Subsequent cards will be used every 4 seconds.
2. **Card Logic Fixes**: Adjusted and fixed various logic issues related to card usage in battles. The effects and impact of cards should now be more noticeable.
3. **Cave Boss Event**: Each cave boss can only be challenged once. There is now a chance to encounter a young Nine-Tailed Fox boss, defeating which may grant a new Nine-Tailed Fox skill tail.
4. **Demon Tribe Home Adjustment**: Enhanced the demon tribe's home with more fire effects for a more hellish atmosphere.
5. **Bug Fixes**: Fixed several battle-related bugs in the cave events and many other miscellaneous bugs.


btw, the playtest version will stop updating from now on. the version will end in 1.14. the demo will keep updating for a while.

notes.title: ### Version Description: 1.12EA Major Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
### Version Description: 1.12EA Major Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox

1. Completely overhauled nearly all skill parameters. Cards now significantly influence battle outcomes. This adjustment is still in progress, primarily completed for human characters.
2. Introduced dozens of special cards, which may contain bugs as they haven't been fully tested.
   (1 and 2 are currently effective only in the Chinese version)
3. Added an information window on the left side to display less important information and other characters' level-up details.
4. Battle displays now show elemental attributes. If attacks are ineffective, it means the attributes are being countered.
5. Notification messages now display the type of currency, defaulting to spirit stones, but different cities may use different resource currencies in shops.
6. Fixed numerous other bugs.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.11EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.11EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
Added an experience bar display. The experience system has been implemented, and you can see it in the companion and status bars.
Added an exploration bar display and fixed exploration bugs.
Added battle speed acceleration display, but there is a bug where there is no sound in accelerated mode.
The camera now automatically follows random characters during battles, and can also be panned manually.
Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.10EA Mid-Sized Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.10EA Mid-Sized Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
Completely revised the leveling system. Previously, talent differences affected combat values, but now combat values will be similar as long as levels are comparable. Talent now influences the speed of leveling up. This means that even with lower talent, long-lived characters have a chance to reach higher levels, reflecting real-world human scenarios more accurately.
The above adjustment is meant to reduce the impact of talent and spiritual roots on combat, allowing skill cards to play a more significant role.
Improved display of various buffs from skills during combat, though currently, it only shows for the player's side. This feature will continue to be refined.
Enhanced tutorials for alchemy and forging, with a bonus gift for the first completion.
Fixed numerous bugs. Upgrading the development engine to the latest version of Unity caused issues, including an inability to export the game at one point, nearly causing a crash.
Discovered an issue where NPCs on the starting island line up in a row, which has not been resolved yet.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.09EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.09EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
Fixed and adjusted the feel and bugs of forging and alchemy.
Fixed bugs in secret realm dungeons.
Player position on islands will no longer reset over time.
Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.08EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.08EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
This update mainly focuses on tutorials and user interface changes:

Added image tutorials for forging.
Various UI optimizations, including a return button for secret realm excavation and new visitor notifications.
For characters with long attack ranges, the mouse can now control the distance when destroying trees and rocks on the map.
Map level display optimization: different exploration area levels now have color changes to remind players not to enter areas that are too high-level.
Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.07EA Minor Update - The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
notes.content:
This minor update includes several changes:

Re-adjusted and fixed the feel and bugs of alchemy.
Optimized sound levels.
The auction house in the sect can now be used normally. Players can sell items within the sect.
Changed the requirement for accessing city trading from 100% exploration to 75%.
More natural treasure and resource drops in the wild and on islands.
Introduced a second race, the Jing, which can be played from the beginning.
Fixed a bug where high-level characters could pass through walls. High-level characters now have significant impact when attacking, especially in the wild.
Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: ### Version Notes: 1.06EA - Monthly Update for "The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox"
notes.content:
### Version Notes: 1.06EA - Monthly Update for "The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox"

This update includes several significant changes:

1. **Combat Mechanism Update**:
    - The rules for using martial arts skill cards have been modified. You can now adjust the card usage order before the battle. During the battle, AI will automatically use the cards in sequence. You can use the ctrl key to watch the battle at multiple speeds. Although the special martial arts effects are not yet fully implemented, improvements are expected in the next version.

2. **Increased Building Interactions**:
    - Almost every building now has interactive functionalities with the player. However, some building functions are still in progress.

3. **Item and Resource Drop Animations**:
    - Added animations for item and resource drops.

4. **Adjusted Number of Portals**:
    - The number of portals has been adjusted.

5. **Optimized Map Character Generation**:
    - The character generation mechanism on the map has been optimized, significantly reducing lag most of the time.

6. **Bug Fixes**:
    - Numerous bugs have been fixed, and the dungeon exploration is now functioning correctly.

notes.title: Version Description: 1.03EA
notes.content:
Version Description: 1.03EA
Major Improvements:

Added support for English language.
Can initiate wars in areas where exploration reaches 100%, capturing them to gain additional resources.
Can steal and rob from NPCs that haven't joined players.
Significantly increased dialogues, including tutorial prompts and some main storyline.
Fixed numerous bugs.
